items.summary: fix(plugins): stop misattributing invalid-config errors to the current plugin tool (#137738) * fix(plugins): stop misattributing invalid-config errors to the current plugin tool When a plugin tool factory throws an InvalidConfigError caused by another plugin's schema (e.g. Codex config), the catch block prefixed it with the current plugin id (e.g. memory-wiki), producing a misleading secondary error in doctor output. Detect InvalidConfigError and log it without the plugin attribution prefix so the originating config path stays visible. Closes #137694 * fix(ci): resolve lint and ratchet CI failures - Add SAFETY comment above type assertion in throwInvalidConfig to satisfy assertion-safety ratchet baseline (io.invalid-config.ts). - Add explicit return before throwInvalidConfig in test IIFE to satisfy consistent-return lint rule (tools.optional.test.ts). * fix(config): preserve distinct invalid-config diagnostics Deduplicate by the complete diagnostic and record it only after logging succeeds. Keep plugin factory errors visible when no owner diagnostic was emitted. Cover changed diagnostics, identical repeats, and logger failures through the real config producer and plugin resolver. --------- Co-authored-by: Altay
